scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config commit.template .gitmessage
scripts.pack: node -e "const v=require('./manifest.json').version;require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});require('child_process').execSync('git archive --format=zip --prefix=SyncReact/ -o dist/SyncReact-v'+v+'.zip HEAD manifest.json src popup icons',{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('dist/SyncReact-v'+v+'.zip')"
